summary: Public health services in the north and north-east are advertising Grade 3 and senior mental health psychology roles, and the clearest matches are the Northern Health leadership role, the RMH P3 role and the Eastern Health community role. Closing dates are unconfirmed for almost all roles (most are leads from listing pages), so check each is still open before applying.
profile: Endorsed Clinical Psychologist (AHPRA general + clinical endorsement), MPsych (Clinical), MAPS, MACPA
15+ years in community mental health, acute inpatient and complex care, including 2.5 years as Senior Practice Leader supervising staff
Clinical Psychologist, Emble Allied Health (Mill Park), private multidisciplinary practice, since 2023
United Minds; Neami National (community mental health, Partners in Recovery, senior practice leadership); Sunshine Hospital acute inpatient placement
Risk assessment, complex case formulation, individual and group therapy, MDT work, GP and NDIS documentation, supervision
CBT, ACT, MI, mindfulness, trauma-informed; anxiety, depression, OCD, emotional dysregulation, trauma, severe and persistent mental illness, complex health needs
Eltham VIC 3095; north and north-east are easy, west and south-east are long
Public health, community mental health, complex care and private practice, including senior roles
